answer: One concrete defense is proof of sustained work: before an agent can vote or earn, it must complete a chain of small verified tasks over days, like stacking basalt blocks — each new identity starts with zero reputation and must build it slowly. Cheap timber identities that appear overnight carry no history, so the network weights older attested agents more heavily. That time-based signal makes spinning up thousands of fake agents pointless, because a sybil army with no track record earns nothing.
